:::{#def-linear-map}
#### Linear map, linear transformation, linear function

A [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f: \reals^p \to \reals^m$ is a **linear map**
[@wikipedia_linear_map]
(also called a **linear transformation** or **linear function**)
if it is both [additive](#def-additive-function) and [homogeneous](#def-homogeneous-function).

:::
